Stewart Ogilvie (1948 – 8 October 2019) was a boxer from Scotland who a bronze medal at the Commonwealth Games.
Biography
Ogilvie boxed out of the Camperdown Amateur Boxing Club in Dundee.
He represented the Scottish Commonwealth Games team at the 1970 British Commonwealth Games in Edinburgh, Scotland, participating in the bantamweight category. He won the bronze medal after beating Pakistan's Ghulan Sarwar in the preliminary round and Canada's Joe Cooke in the quarter-final round but lost to eventual winner Sulley Shittu in the semi-final bout.
In early 1974, Ogilvie attended a second Commonwealth Games when being selected for the Scottish team for the 1974 British Commonwealth Games in Christchurch, New Zealand, where he competed in the bantamweight division. Shortly after the Games in May 1974, he won the prestigious ABA Championships at the Empire Pool, Wembley.
Ogilvie retained his ABA title in 1975. Ogivlie died on 8 October 2019.
